quandoUsar: Frequently asked questions on a pricing or help page, with `size="lg"` for questions in large text and answers in reading-size body text.
Supporting information that only some people need, such as billing or privacy details, without taking anyone off the page.
Lists where only one answer needs to stay open: opening an item closes the previous one, and clicking the open item closes it.
quandoEvitar: Use `bouncy-accordion` when you need several items open at the same time or controlled state; this accordion only has `defaultOpen`.
Use `collapsible` for a single region that opens and closes next to its own title.
Use `faq-section` when the page needs a whole section of questions, with topics or search.

teclado.acao: Opens the focused item and closes the one that was open; on an item that is already open, closes it.
Moves focus to the next or previous title, wrapping to the first after the last.
Moves focus to the first or last title.

acessibilidade: Built on the Radix Accordion: each title is a `<button>` inside an `<h3>`, with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, and each panel is a `region` tied to its title.
When it finishes collapsing, the panel gets `visibility: hidden` and leaves the Tab order and the accessibility tree; the screen reader only finds the open answer.
The heading level is fixed at `<h3>`; if the page hierarchy calls for another level, use `bouncy-accordion`, which accepts `headingLevel`.
movimento: The panel height follows the content on a no-overshoot spring, and the answer moves down 6 px out of a slight blur as it appears.
The arrow rotates 180° on a short spring; switching items mid-animation redirects the height instead of restarting.
With “reduce motion” on, panels and arrow go straight to the final state, without animation.
responsivo: At size `lg`, below 520 px the minimum title height drops from 76 to 68 px and the fonts go down one step.
notasIA: The first item starts open (`defaultOpen` is 0); pass `defaultOpen={-1}` to start with everything closed.
Items are `{ title, content }`: `title` is plain text and `content` accepts any React node; there is no `value` or `onValueChange`.
Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/accordion/accordion`; it takes 100% of the width, so limit the width on the parent (the demo uses 520 px).
